newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hualing in HK$152 million rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Hualing in HK$152 million rights issue.

text.p: Hualing Holdings Ltd plans to raise HK$152 million by way of a rights issue of 200 million new shares in the proportion of one rights share for every three shares held at a price of HK$0.76 per rights share, the company said in a statement published on Friday.
Hualing shares ended at HK$0.76 per share on Thursday.

The China-based refrigerator maker said about HK$58 million of the proceeds would be used to fund its investment in its 50 percent owned refrigerator compressor maker Xian Dongling Refrigerator Compressor Co Ltd.
Another HK$39 million was earmarked for the expansion of its princiapl subsidiary China Refrigerator Industry Co Ltd and the remaining balance will be for working capital, it said.
On Thursday, Hualing reported a 65.35 percent fall iin interim profit to HK$16.35 million for the first half of 1996.
